integrity: The infinite assertions have an explicit combinatorial proof. The verifier checks finite cases only, and independent audit has not been performed. Source literature is credited and any unexamined related work is disclosed.
scientific_limitations: The exact minimum and incidence criterion hold for n>=3; the complete minimum-set component classification and Cayley enumeration are proved for n>=8. Exact enumeration of all liar's dominating sets and arbitrary line graphs is not claimed. An older equivalent incidence-cover result remains an originality risk.
title: Liar's vertex-edge domination of triangular graphs and its minimum-set census
